# 2.2: generated Go vs hand-written Go

Each fixture is a real aimux-core value serialized with serde (the truth). It is decoded and re-marshaled by the generated Go (`aimux-codegen --emit go`) and by the hand-written `bindings/go/types.go` + `multimodal_types.go`. A row is a JSON path where the two outputs differ. The verdict says which side disagrees with the Rust output. The test also requires the generated output to equal the Rust output for every fixture.

Untagged overlap: `image-result-overlap` has `"images":[]`, which is a valid `Base64(Vec<String>)` and a valid `Binary(Vec<Vec<u8>>)` (`ImageOutputs`, image_model.rs). serde picks the first declared variant. The generated Go picked: `image-result-binary` → `Binary`, `image-result-overlap` → `Base64`.
